records.quote: In this work, we have employed a growth-from-the-melt technique followed by hot pressing to prepare polycrystalline Ag8GeSe6 samples, on which the crystal structure, micro-morphology, compositional analysis, UV vis absorption, specific heat, speed of sound, and thermoelectric properties were characterized as a function of the Se-deficiency ratio and temperature.

records.subject: Polycrystalline Ag8GeSe6 samples
records.quote: In this work, we have employed a growth-from-the-melt technique followed by hot pressing to prepare polycrystalline Ag8GeSe6 samples, on which the crystal structure, micro-morphology, compositional analysis, UV vis absorption, specific heat, speed of sound, and thermoelectric properties were characterized as a function of the Se-deficiency ratio and temperature.

records.quote: The electronic structures in solid state transition metal compounds can be represented by two parameters: the charge-transfer energy (Delta), which is the energy difference between the p-band of an anion and an upper Hubbard band contributed by transition-metal d-orbitals, and the onsite Coulomb repulsion energy (U), which represents the energy difference between lower and upper Hubbard bands composed of split d-orbitals in transition metals.
context_quotes: These parameters can facilitate the classification of various types of electronic structures.

records.subject: Charge-transfer energy Delta
records.object: Anion species: N3−, P3−, As3−, O2−, S2−, Se2−, Te2−, F−, Cl−, Br−, I−
records.conditions: Ionic-model calculations for 566 binary and ternary 3d transition-metal compounds across 11 families; trend signs unspecified
records.quote: In this study, the dependences of anion species (N3-, P3-, As3-, O2-, S2-, Se2-, Te2-, F-, Cl-, Br-, and I-) on Delta and U of 566 different binary and ternary 3d transition-metal compounds were investigated using ionic-model calculations.
context_quotes: We were able to identify the systematic chemical trends in the variations in Delta and U values with the anion species of 11 different families of 3d transition-metal compounds in a comprehensive manner.
